helpIntro: Rutgers-New Brunswick uses a 4.0 scale with B+=3.5 and C+=2.5. Enter Rutgers credits and final grades to estimate your current or projected GPA.
helpNote: This profile is for Rutgers-New Brunswick School of Arts and Sciences undergraduate GPA planning. Transfer grades are excluded. The repeat estimate applies only to eligible SAS D/F repeats; other Rutgers schools may use different rules.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12 grade points; a 4-credit B+ earns 14. Together, 26 ÷ 7 = 3.714.

gradeExplanations.D: D = 1.0 point per credit; an eligible SAS repeat may later receive an E prefix.
gradeExplanations.F: F = 0 points and its credits count in GPA unless an eligible SAS repeat is E-prefixed.
gradeExplanations.P: Pass earns degree credit but is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.NC: No Credit earns no degree credit and is excluded from GPA.

specialTypes.name: Rutgers-New Brunswick graded course
specialTypes.note: Use for finalized Rutgers-New Brunswick grades on the standard A/B+/B/C+/C/D/F scale.

specialTypes.name: Approved external transfer credit
specialTypes.note: External transfer grades do not enter the Rutgers cumulative GPA.

specialTypes.name: E-prefixed Rutgers course
specialTypes.note: An E prefix means no degree credit and the grade is excluded from the cumulative GPA.

specialTypes.name: Rutgers course under another school/program policy
specialTypes.note: Business, graduate, professional, and other school-specific policies can differ; confirm the transcript treatment before calculating.

repeatPolicy.note: For an eligible SAS D/F repeat taken at Rutgers-New Brunswick, the original can be E-prefixed and removed from the cumulative GPA while the repeated grade counts. Limits and exceptions still require SAS review.
